title: 第三章 道义为先第章 新的护卫任务
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
四海武馆不传轻功，听说就算是馆主郑四海，轻功也是一塌糊涂。
所以从不传授卖丑。
也因此导致方书文对轻功一窍不通，但他内功深厚，大踏步跑起来，速度也快若奔马。
只是一边朝着主院方向跑，一边心中却在疑惑。
宋理应该是去撒尿的时候被杀的，距离现在差不多正好一个多时辰，这帮人就已经摸进了周家。
可为什么当时不动手，而是要等这一个时辰？
周家最惹人眼热的就是银子，这帮人却不要银子，而要命。
来的显然不是寻常的暗挂子，而是得罪了什么要命的对手。
正想着呢，就见眼前呼喊，两个黑衣人正在追杀几个丫鬟仆役。
这些丫鬟仆役都不会武功，被人追的上天无路，入地无门，刀锋起落便是一条人命。
方书文眸子里杀机一闪，不等靠近，右拳一握，凌空一拳狠狠打出。
他所学的【四海龙拳】本是出自于【大龙拳】。
而【大龙拳】则脱胎于马上枪术，只是舍了那杆龙枪，换成了双拳对敌。
郑四海学会了这套拳法之后，融会贯通再创新招，填上了‘四海’二字，变成了现如今的【四海龙拳】。
但归根结底，拳法的核心要义，仍旧是以枪术为主。
讲究的是点，扫，横，劈，挑等，招式方面大开大合，以力为主，以快为辅。
如今方书文内功大成，凌空一拳打出，拳劲如枪，奔走如龙。
尚未到得跟前，拳劲已经轰杀在了一个黑人的胸口。
那人身形顿时一震，先是一抹血雾自背后窜出，紧跟着整个人被这力道震碎，以至于四分五裂。
另外一个黑衣人眼见于此，顿时脸色大变。

想都不想，转身就走，可此时方书文已经到了跟前，右拳顺势一扫，就听得碰的一声，那黑衣人整个脑袋竟然被这一扫给打飞了出去。
几个丫鬟仆役甚至来不及高兴于死中得活，便被眼前这可怕的场景吓得脸色惨白。
“呆着作甚？还不逃命去？”
方书文喝了一声，将他们惊醒，也不在原地停留，继续朝着主院赶去。
同时也在心中告诫自己，如今自己内功深厚，远不是先前可比。
出手的时候得悠着点，不然的话，场面太过血腥难看。
一路走来，所过之处各种惨叫声此起彼伏。
这帮人闯进周府大开杀戒，甚至还有人迫不及待的，当着其他人的面，就去撕扯丫鬟的衣服欲行不轨之事。
方书文出手无情，见者皆杀。
短短的时间里，杀的人比过去十九年都多得多。
如此一来，倒是对自己的力道掌控越发得心应手。
其实他不是掌握不好，而是拿捏不好出手的分寸，他用多大的力气，自己心里有数，但对方能够承受多大的力道，就不太好说了。
这一路杀来最大的收获，便是摸清楚了这帮人的承受极限。
在恰好能够杀了他们的同时，不至于弄的到处都是残肢断臂。
终于，主院已经就在眼前。
他纵身一跃跳上了墙头，就见主院之中，周飞雄和他夫人早就已经醒来，正被家中几个供奉保护在中间。
其中一人方书文还认识。
这人叫王涛，和四海武馆的大师兄莫北斗于江湖相逢。
一见如故，引为知己。
正是通过此人，莫北斗方才能够将他引荐到周家做护院武师。

对面的这群黑衣人武功极高，为首的是一个面色阴鸷的中年人。
正隔空和周飞雄对望。
周飞雄虽然不会武功，可气势并不弱，四目相对之间，冷声开口
“尔等究竟是何来历？
content_en:
Sihai Martial Arts School does not teach Qinggong. I heard that even the owner of the gym, Zheng Sihai, is a mess in Qinggong.
Therefore, we never teach about being ugly.
As a result, Fang Shuwen knew nothing about Qing Gong, but he had profound internal energy and could run as fast as a galloping horse.
He just ran towards the main courtyard, but he was still doubting in his heart.
Song Li was probably killed when he went to urinate. Almost exactly over an hour ago, these people had already entered Zhou's house.
But why didn't you take action at that time instead of waiting for this hour?
The most eye-catching thing about the Zhou family is money, but these people don't want money, but their lives.
The one who came was obviously not an ordinary secret trick, but someone who had offended some deadly opponent.
Just as he was thinking about it, he saw shouting in front of him. Two men in black were chasing several maids and servants.
These maids and servants don't know martial arts. They are chased with no way to the sky or to the earth. The rise and fall of the blade is a human life.
Fang Shuwen's eyes flashed with murderous intent. Before he could get closer, he clenched his right fist and punched hard in the air.
The [Four Sea Dragon Fist] he learned was originally derived from the [Big Dragon Fist].
The [Big Dragon Fist] was born out of the horse-mounted spear technique, but instead of the dragon spear, it was used to fight the enemy with two fists.
After Zheng Sihai learned this boxing technique, he integrated it and made new moves, adding the word "Sihai" to it, and it became the current "Sihai Dragon Fist".
But in the final analysis, the core essence of boxing is still spearmanship.
The emphasis is on points, sweeps, horizontals, splits, picks, etc. In terms of moves, power is the main force and speed is the supplement.
Now that Fang Shuwen has perfected his internal strength, he punches out in the air with force like a spear and runs like a dragon.
Before he could reach him, his fist had already struck a black man in the chest.
The man's figure suddenly shook. First, a trace of blood mist came out from behind, and then the whole man was shattered by the force, so that it fell into pieces.
When the other man in black saw this, his expression suddenly changed.
Without thinking, he turned around and left, but at this time Fang Shuwen was already in front of him. He swiped his right fist and heard a bang. The whole head of the man in black was blown away by this swipe.
Several maids and servants didn't even have time to rejoice in surviving death, before they turned pale with fright at the horrific scene in front of them.
"What are you doing here? Why don't you run for your life?"
Fang Shuwen shouted and woke them up. He did not stop where he was and continued to rush towards the main courtyard.
At the same time, I also warned myself in my heart that my internal strength is now far from what it was before.
You have to take your time when taking action, otherwise, the scene will be too bloody and ugly.
Along the way, all kinds of screams came one after another wherever they passed.
This group of people broke into Zhou's mansion and started killing. Some even couldn't wait to tear off the maid's clothes in front of other people in order to do evil things.
Fang Shuwen was ruthless and killed everyone he saw.
In a short period of time, many more people were killed than in the previous nineteen years.
As a result, he became more and more able to control his own strength.
In fact, it's not that he doesn't have good control, but he doesn't know the right amount of his attack. He knows how much force he will use, but it's hard to say how much force the other party can withstand.
The biggest gain from this fight was to find out the limits of what this group of people could bear.
Just enough to kill them without leaving limbs and limbs everywhere.
Finally, the main courtyard was in sight.
He jumped onto the wall and saw that in the main courtyard, Zhou Feixiong and his wife had already woken up and were being protected by several family members.
I still know one of them, Fang Shuwen.
This man's name is Wang Tao, and he meets Mo Beidou, the senior brother of Sihai Martial Arts School.
We feel like old friends at first sight and become close friends.
It was through this person that Mo Beidou was able to introduce him to the Zhou family as a martial arts guardian.
The group of men in black across from them were extremely skilled in martial arts, and they were led by a middle-aged man with a sinister expression.
Just separated by space and weekTobio looked at each other.
Although Zhou Feixiong did not know martial arts, his aura was not weak. Their eyes met and he spoke coldly.
"Where did you come from?
